notes.title: Patch 1.04 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've added the following features to this new patch:

- Monster Brawl! (You are able to fight monsters in select levels of difficulty. Please talk to Karen to begin. She's the slime-receptionist of the fighting counter, located in Gronto Seer.)

- Minor Issue fixes! Thanks to our lovely [url=https://discord.gg/SGmVEBB]Discord[/url] members!

That's all for now, enjoy!

notes.title: Quick Fix 1.03
notes.content:
Hello again!

Today we've added some changes to the 1.03 update of the game.

- Added a difficulty totem in the navai shrine.
- Fixed minor issues in the game.

Please rest easy as we'll be tackling other issues later on if any.
Thanks again!

You can join us on [url=https://discord.gg/KAqv97W]Discord[/url] for more updates!
